method: Each returned PNG viewed at full size beside its identity reference and at 106x152 card size; bytes, original identity, C2PA presence, prompt and input hashes recomputed by script.
common_findings: Full body with the whole head, both hands (one at the waist, one at the side, fingers visible) and both shoes inside the frame; one subject; no text, flags, insignia, watermark or other people; outlined cel-shaded adult cartoon in the anchor style; opaque dark-teal background with gentle vignette shading (border mean within 11 levels of #192D34 on every channel).
